posts.text:
The fact that being 'anti-AC' is an actual political position shows you just how stupid large swathes of humanity are.

It's essentially a pro-death position.

It's as stupid as being against heating in the winter.

Real Talk with Zuby (@ZubyPodcast)

"I would be much more scared to be surrounded by mostly atheists."

Christian frameworks built Western civilisation. The American South still runs on them. Most of modern America doesn't.

@JTLonsdale  read a lot of history as a kid, so he knows what the world looked like before the West got it right. Much nastier... Scarier. Poorer. More savage.

The veneer of civilisation is much thinner than people realise.
